steps.title: Opening Question
steps.content:
So {{contact_first_name}}, how have you felt since you finished your chiropractic care with us? I usually hear one of three things. Still feeling great, starting to flare up, or pretty much back to where you started. Which one is closest for you?

(Only three answers. Tap the one you hear.)

steps.title: Still Feeling Great
steps.content:
That's great to hear, {{contact_first_name}}. That's exactly what we hope for when someone finishes care with us. {{provider_name}} will be glad to know you're still doing well.

(Let them respond, then continue.)

steps.title: Starting to Flare Up
steps.content:
Thanks for telling me, {{contact_first_name}}. Your notes say you were moving and feeling better when you finished. What seems to bring the flare-up on?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Fully Back
steps.content:
I'm sorry to hear that, {{contact_first_name}}. Your notes say you were moving and feeling better when you finished. What do you think brought it back?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Ask Permission
steps.content:
While I have you, {{contact_first_name}}, can I ask you a few quick questions about anything else you've noticed?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: Transition: Ask Permission
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, we'll come back to the flare-up you mentioned. First, can I ask a few quick questions so your file is up to date?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name.)

{{contact_first_name}}, I'm going to run through a few things people often notice. Just say yes if you get them at all, even if they're mild or come and go.

Have you been getting headaches?

Have you noticed fatigue or low energy?

How's your sleep been?

Any allergies or sinus stuff?

Have you noticed more stress or irritability?

Are you having any tension, pain, or soreness?

Are you taking any medications for these concerns?

Of those, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Questions: Flare-Up
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name.)

{{contact_first_name}}, I'm going to run through a few things people often notice. Just say yes if you get them at all, even if they're mild or come and go.

Have you been getting headaches?

Have you noticed fatigue or low energy?

How's your sleep been?

Any allergies or sinus stuff?

Have you noticed more stress or irritability?

Are you having any tension, pain, or soreness?

Are you taking any medications for these concerns?

Between the flare-up and these concerns, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Making It Real
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'd like to ask three quick questions about {{main_concern}}. This will help us update your file.

How long has it been bothering you, like a week or two, or longer than that?

(Let them answer.)

Is it something you experience like 1 to 2 times a month, or is it more often than that?

(Let them answer.)

When it's at its worst, does it ever interfere with work, at home, or relaxing and doing your own thing?

(Let them answer. Repeat back whatever they name.)

Thank you for sharing that.

steps.title: The Recommendation
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in so {{provider_name}} can take a look at {{main_concern}}. If chiropractic care may help, we'll explain the options. If not, we'll tell you that too. Does that sound reasonable?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: They Hesitate: Find Out Why
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I don't want to assume anything. Is it the timing, or is something else holding you back?

(Stay easy about it. Let them answer.)

steps.title: Nothing Found: Why Did They Stop?
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'm glad you're still feeling good.

Can I ask what changed that led you to stop coming in?

(Let them answer. Do not argue with it.)

(Tap the reason they give.)

steps.title: Reason: Feeling Fine
steps.content:
That makes sense, {{contact_first_name}}. When you feel good, coming in stops feeling urgent. Regular chiropractic checks can catch small changes before they start bothering you.

Would you like to keep feeling this way?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they share another reason, tap that reason. Otherwise, continue.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule for a regular check. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Reason: Cost or Insurance
steps.content:
I understand, {{contact_first_name}}. A regular check is one visit, and you aren't committing to more care. We can explain the cost before you decide anything.

Would that help?

(Let them answer.)

(Do not quote prices, packages, or discounts.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they share another reason, tap that reason. Otherwise, continue.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule for a check. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Reason: Life Got Busy
steps.content:
I hear you, {{contact_first_name}}. Life fills up fast, and regular chiropractic checks can get pushed down the list. We can find a time that works around your schedule.

Would that work?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they share another reason, tap that reason. Otherwise, continue.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's find an easy time for a check. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Reason: Waiting for Pain
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}. Small changes can start before they hurt. A regular chiropractic check lets us look before the problem becomes harder to ignore.

Is that worth checking now?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they share another reason, tap that reason. Otherwise, continue.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get a check on the schedule. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Reason: Moved or Changed Offices
steps.content:
That's understandable, {{contact_first_name}}. Things change. If you're still nearby, we'd be glad to see you again. Your chiropractic history is already in your file.

Would coming back here be easier?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they share another reason, tap that reason. Otherwise, continue.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Objection: “It came back after I stopped”
steps.content:
That can happen when regular adjustments stop. A visit lets us see what changed and talk through your options.

Can we get you in for a look?

steps.title: Objection: “I thought I was fixed for good”
steps.content:
That's fair. Daily movement can bring pain or stiffness back over time. A chiropractic check can show us what's changed.

Would you be open to that?

steps.title: Objection: Injections or Surgery
steps.content:
I understand why you're considering those options. A visit lets you ask where chiropractic care might fit before you decide.

Would having that information help?

(Wait for the answer.)

steps.title: Objection: “I’m managing on my own”
steps.content:
I understand. Managing it yourself may help for now. A chiropractic visit can check why it keeps bothering you.

Is it worth taking a closer look?

steps.title: Transition: Fully Back
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, we'll come back to the problem that's fully back. First, can I ask a few quick questions so your file is up to date?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: Questions: Fully Back
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name.)

{{contact_first_name}}, I'm going to run through a few things people often notice. Just say yes if you get them at all, even if they're mild or come and go.

Have you been getting headaches?

Have you noticed fatigue or low energy?

How's your sleep been?

Any allergies or sinus stuff?

Have you noticed more stress or irritability?

Are you having any tension, pain, or soreness?

Are you taking any medications for these concerns?

Between the original problem and these concerns, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Objection: “I need to think”
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}. What part would you like to think over?

(Listen. Tap the matching reason if they give one.)

The first visit gives you information about {{main_concern}}. Then you can decide what feels right.

Does that help?

steps.title: Objection: “Send me information”
steps.content:
I'd be glad to send information, {{contact_first_name}}. General information cannot explain what's happening with {{main_concern}}. A chiropractic visit can give you answers about your situation.

Would you like to schedule the visit too?
